remarks: Great opportunity to make this your next home! This 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom is set in a nice community, and is located near the local shopping center, movie theater, restaurants and minutes to historic downtown Santa Paula. If you are tired of paying rent, this is a wonderful opportunity for a first time buyer to capture your own piece of Santa Paula. Others thinking about downsizing or adding to your investment portfolio can also take advantage of this nice unit with great potential. The property offer an attached 2-car garage with laundry area and direct access. There is also an enclosed patio area with a slider from the living room. Plus owners have access to the communities sparkling pool
